equipment_list_writes.write: At 11010-11011, IsPetEgg(decoded item ID) && m_isDamaged assigns m_petEggIndex=m_itemIndex, before wearLocation branch at 11012.
At 11103-11104, same predicate and assignment, before wearLocation branch at 11105.
At 11199-11200, same predicate and assignment, before wearLocation branch at 11201.

exact_list_behavior: At list start, handlers clear equipment rows only (10972-10973, 11064-11065, 11158-11159); they do not clear m_petEggIndex. They walk wire entries in order and overwrite the index for every eligible row before the wearLocation split: last eligible wire row wins regardless of wearLocation. With no eligible row the old index remains. Primary CSession AddItem, SetItem, Remove-equivalent SetItem(num=0), ClearEquipItemInInventory, and ClearItem contain no m_petEggIndex writes (Ref/Session.cpp:3043-3135, 16054-16139, 16191-16208, 25238-25291).
identified_and_card_semantics: Equipment entries decode item ID, identified flag, damaged flag, and four slot/card words. Egg-index predicate uses item ID and damaged flag only; it does not test identified state or card values.

other_primary_index_writes.behavior: Successful item-identify action sets m_isDamaged=1, calls SetItem, then assigns m_petEggIndex=info.m_itemIndex.
Return egg gets row by index, sets m_isDamaged=0, calls SetItem, then clears index and m_petJob to -1.
Return egg gets row by index, sets m_num=0, calls SetItem, then clears index and m_petJob to -1.

selected_production_mapping.equipment_inventory: 0x00A4 basic/20-byte; 0x02D0 timed-owned/26-byte. Selected 24-byte timed-only ID disabled; 0x01EF is historical normal-cart, not selected equipment inventory.
selected_production_mapping.handlers: HandleNormalInventoryList at GameModePacket.cpp:2087-2125; HandleEquipInventoryList at 2128-2158. BuildEquipInventoryItem at 1733-1779 decodes item ID, identified, damaged, all four slots, and optional timed fields.
